Which replicates contribute to each consensus region

Source: R/plots.R
plotUpset.Rd

An UpSet plot of the replicate combinations found across the consensus regions. Regions supported by every replicate should dominate; a large partial set points at a replicate that is pulling in a different direction.

Usage

plotUpset(object, minSize = 0)

Arguments

object

A [ConsensusRegions-class] object.

minSize

Drop intersections smaller than this. Default: 0.

Value

A `ggplot` object built by `ComplexUpset`.

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio

Examples

peakFiles <- system.file("extdata",
                         c("rep1.narrowPeak", "rep2.narrowPeak",
                           "rep3.narrowPeak"),
                         package = "consensusRegions")
peaks <- readPeakSets(peakFiles, sampleNames = c("r1", "r2", "r3"),
                      verbose = FALSE)
result <- buildConsensus(peaks, verbose = FALSE)

if (requireNamespace("ComplexUpset", quietly = TRUE)) {
    plotUpset(result)
}
